short_description: Step Back in Time: Discover Pearl Harbor and Honolulu’s WWII History
cancellation_summary: No refund unless canceled more than 48 hours before the start time.
meeting_point: Pick-up from Waikiki/Honolulu hotels only. Contact for other areas.
pricing:
- Adult (13+): $69
- Child (4-12): $45
- Children (0-3): Free

Lockers at Pearl Harbor($5)
description: Step back in time to one of the most significant events in Honolulu’s World War II history. Every visitor to Honolulu should experience the historic sites at Pearl Harbor. Gain a new appreciation for Honolulu’s history as your knowledgeable guide shares important facts about the attack and its role in our country’s development.

what_is_included_items.value: Transportation to and from Pearl Harbor
Tickets for the USS Arizona Memorial
Guided Honolulu Historic Highlights City Tour

itinerary:
- **USS Arizona Memorial**: Documentary film, ferry ride, memorial visit
- **Hawaii State Capitol**: Historical and political site
- **King Kamehameha Statue**: Photo opportunity
-**Kawaiaha’o Church** Historic Landmarks
- **‘Iolani Palace**: Exterior view from the statue
highlights:
- Transportation to Pearl Harbor Visitor Center
- Tickets for the boat ride to the USS Arizona Memorial
- King Kamehameha Statue photo opportunity
- Honolulu historic landmarks city tour
check_in_details: Please arrive at your pickup location at least 10 minutes early. Drivers will wait up to 5 minutes for late arrivals.

what_to_bring_items.value: No bags allowed at Pearl Harbor

restrictions:
- Pick-up available only from Waikiki/Honolulu hotels.
- Lockers at Pearl Harbor have long lines; best not to bring bags.
faqs:
- **Are bags allowed at Pearl Harbor?** No, all bags are prohibited, including camera bags and fanny packs.
- **What happens if I miss my pickup?** Drivers wait up to 5 minutes, but no refunds are issued for no-shows.
